name: Jeffrey Dahmer
summary: Asesino en serie estadounidense que cometió diecisiete homicidios entre 1978 y 1991, principalmente en Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Fue condenado a dieciséis cadenas perpetuas. Murió en prisión en 1994.

murders.method: Golpeado hasta la muerte en estado de embriaguez.
murders.sourceQuote: November 20: Steven Walter Tuomi, 25. Killed in a rented room at the Ambassador Hotel in Milwaukee.
January 16: James Edward Doxtator, 14. Dahmer encountered Doxtator at a bus stop outside a gay bar in Wisconsin

murders.method: Drogado y estrangulado en el dormitorio.
murders.sourceQuote: He bleached and retained the skull for several months before disposing of it. No remains were ever found.
His preserved skull and genitals were found in a filing cabinet at 924 North 25th Street
Smith was a male sex worker whom Dahmer encountered at a tavern. Dahmer gave Smith a drink laced with sleeping pills, then strangled him on his kitchen floor.
September 2: Ernest Marquez Miller, 22. Miller was a dance student whom Dahmer encountered outside a bookstore.

murders.method: Drogado y estrangulado con una correa de cuero.
murders.sourceQuote: July 15: Oliver Joseph Lacy, 24. A bodybuilding enthusiast whom Dahmer enticed to his apartment with the promise of money
